text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-38192 fired for KMS decrypts (service=kms-proxy, env=prod)
pagerduty: Page fired -> SRE Oncall
alice_ng: acked. I'm looking. seeing spike of `429` from /v1/decrypt across multiple regions.
miguel_ops: same, metrics show connection resets to hsm-cluster-eu-1 around 12:02 UTC. errors: `tls: handshake failure` and `connection reset by peer`.
alice_ng: paste logs:
```
2026-03-14T12:02:05Z kms-proxy hsm-conn error="tls: certificate signed by unknown authority" target=hsm-eu-1:443
2026-03-14T12:02:07Z kms-proxy decrypt status=429 client=svc-product retry=0
```
oncall_sre: is this the cert rotation that was scheduled? security runbook said rotation window 11:00-11:30 UTC but this is 12:02.
support_lead: customers reporting "failed to decrypt" during uploads, ~3% of requests. Not yet a major outage but visible errors for several customers.
alice_ng: paging chain: PD escalated to security-oncall after 2 acks due to HSM vendor alert about forced connection resets.
miguel_ops: quick mitigation options: 1) enable software-fallback (unwrap cached CEKs) 2) route traffic to hsm-eu-2 (still on old cert) 3) throttle client concurrency with 10s backoff.
alice_ng: doing (1) now: `POST /admin/fallback?enable=true` -> enabling cached-key fallback. Expecting reduced 429s within 30s.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: routing update to kms-proxy started (rollout id=roll-9982)
pagerduty: PD-38192 acknowledged by alice_ng
oncall_sre: mike from security says vendor rotated CA unexpectedly; vendor support engaged.
alice_ng: fallback enabled -> seeing 429s drop to ~0.6% within 90s. Confirmed decrypt success rate up.
miguel_ops: still see some TLS handshake retries in logs but rate much lower. I'll keep a throttling patch open: `--max-conns=1200` -> temporary set to 800 to reduce connection churn.
tara_eng: i'll take handoff at 12:30 UTC. summary for next oncall: vendor CA rotation caused HSM connections to reset, triggered 429s from kms-proxy; mitigated by enabling cached-key software fallback and reducing proxy concurrency; vendor support engaged; need to validate cert rollout and add fallback test.
support_lead: notifying affected customers with templated message: 'We briefly saw decrypt failures due to upstream HSM cert rotation; mitigation applied and no data loss.'
alice_ng: notes for postmortem: - add alert dedupe for bursts of 429s - add automated fallback test to cert rotation runbook - consider circuit-breaker to degrade to cached-key mode sooner - coordinate cert rotation windows with vendor and our oncall.
oncall_sre: handing off to tara_eng now :point_right: tara_eng, confirm you have access to fallback toggle and KMS proxy runbook.
tara_eng: got it. ack. will monitor next 30 min then open a follow-up postmortem ticket.
incident-bot: PD-38192 resolved (status=mitigated) :white_check_mark:
